name: OpenDIMS Integration
brief: Exposes BC data OpenDIMS needs that the standard API does not cover.
description: Publishes read-only API endpoints for OpenDIMS: salesShipments and salesInvoiceLinks (shipment tracking), customerDiscountGroups, itemDiscountGroups and priceListLines (discount matrix sync), bomComponents (assembly BOM / composed products), odsItems and tableFields (every item field the standard API leaves out, including fields other extensions added to the item card), itemBomCosts (assembly BOM cost roll-up) and itemStatistics (item ledger figures). Ships granular permission sets (OPENDIMS TRACKING / DISCOUNTS / BOM / ITEMS) so each integration is granted only the data it uses.
